source_title: Why I Dropped Wordpress For Payhip

snippets.snippet_text: "Deep customization – PayHip has a limited number of themes and layout blocks. Advanced SEO tools – No Yoast or keyword analysis dashboards. Traditional blogging features – You can post updates, but PayHip isn't a blog-first platform. But I gained peace of mind and writing time. And honestly? That was the trade I needed to make."
